# Pull request

## Purpose

State the observable change, its scope, and remaining limits.

## Validation

List the exact checks and host/toolchain used. Distinguish local evidence from
CI status. Include a focused rejection case when semantics change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Required proofs, checks, and cleanup are not weakened.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog describe current behavior accurately.
- [ ] Relevant format, lint, and tests pass.
